About the Laboratory

Advancing AI-driven image analysis and intelligent systems for medical and real-world applications.

Muthu Subash Kavitha studies machine learning, image analysis, and computer-aided diagnosis to build intelligent systems that support healthcare, perception, and data-driven decision-making.
